_doc: Per-leaf SCOPE decisions for GOLD-LAYOUT. Decided by Sir 2026-08-28 (18 OUT). RE-EVALUATED 2026-08-29 by R16.5, which widened CLASSES with AN/OR/DC/TB/DT/CO. ⚠️ Sir's DECISION is untouched; his CRITERION is what changed answer. Every one of the 18 was put out because a genre had no correct label, and 15 of the 18 said so in the same words — 'table and index rows have no correct answer in CLASSES'. Those words are now false. The 2026-08-28 reason is preserved per leaf as `why_2026-08-28`; nothing is overwritten.
_criterion: OUT only when NO object on the leaf has a correct answer in CLASSES — title page, key to the marks, table of contents, standalone argument pages. NOT out merely because a leaf is front matter: preface prose (NT-1582-B_0008, _0009) uses RH/MT/MN correctly and stays IN. ⚠️ 2026-08-29: applied against the WIDENED class set. Under it NO leaf in this corpus is out of scope. That is the criterion working, not a bar being cleared by redefinition — the denominator GREW, 190 -> 208.
_warning: OUT OF SCOPE IS NOT A PASS. Out-of-scope leaves contribute nothing to GOLD-LAYOUT and are counted apart from it. Run plate_scope.py to see the IN-SCOPE count against R16.1's >=125 bar. Excluding leaves until a bar clears is forbidden; if the bar stops being met the deliverable stays OPEN.
_unsolved: RESOLVED AS TO ONTOLOGY, OPEN AS TO RECOGNITION. The ANNOTATIONS genre now has `AN`, so OT1-1609-B_0417 and NT-1582-B_0036 have one correct answer between them instead of two wrong ones. ⚠️ NO CUE EMITS `AN` — R16.5 removed the misfiling TARGET, not the misfiling. ⚠️ AND E22 IS STILL UNREACHED: OT1-1609-P_0024 carries the key to the marks AND the Argument of Genesis on ONE leaf. A leaf-level scope field cannot express that whatever the class set says; it is archetype F, Roadmap R12.3.
